set.question: Which expression shows a regular eating habit?

options: I often prepare homemade food because I want to know what ingredients it contains.
I never cook at home because I do not care what the ingredients are.

I never cooked, so I bought balanced dishes at the supermarket every week.

The change failed, so I stopped every new habit I had started that year.
I decided to change the habits before trying them out at home first.
